<issue>
Snowflake colon extraction with single quotes not properly escaped

#### Description

When parsing Snowflake's colon extraction syntax with single quotes in the path (e.g., `col:"a'b"`), the single quotes are not being properly escaped when converting to `GET_PATH` function calls. This causes incorrect SQL generation during roundtrip operations.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import sqlglot

# This should properly escape the single quote
sql = "SELECT col:\"customer's department\""
parsed = sqlglot.parse(sql, dialect="snowflake")[0]
result = parsed.sql(dialect="snowflake")
print("Result:", result)
print("Expected: SELECT GET_PATH(col, '[\"customer\\'s department\"]')")

# Another example with single quotes
sql2 = "SELECT col:`fr'uit`"  
parsed2 = sqlglot.parse(sql2, dialect="databricks")[0]
result2 = parsed2.sql(dialect="databricks")
print("Result:", result2)
print("Expected: SELECT col:[\"fr'uit\"]")
```

The issue occurs when the colon extraction contains quoted identifiers with single quotes - the escaping logic that was previously handling this case appears to have been removed, causing incorrect SQL generation.
</issue>
